purpose: Create original image, animation, video, character, UI and media assets quickly without confusing concepts, approvals, provenance, runtime proof, or release authority.

requires: approved references by path or evidence reference
stages.failClosed: unknown ownership or licensing stays UNKNOWN

videoRequirements.masterPreference: lossless or high-quality intermediate before delivery encode

characterConsistency.rule: Exploration may vary unlocked attributes; production variants preserve locked identity unless Professor explicitly changes the design.

toolPolicy.imageGeneration: may create or edit original visual candidates from the approved brief
toolPolicy.blender: use for 3D modeling rigging animation rendering and turntables when available
toolPolicy.godot: use for runtime staging animation and UI integration when appropriate
toolPolicy.ffmpeg: use for deterministic transcode mux frame extraction audio/video inspection and delivery packaging
toolPolicy.rule: A planned tool step is not evidence that the tool ran. Store receipts from actual executions.

truthBoundaries: A still image does not prove animation.
A successful encode does not prove visual correctness.
A generated asset does not establish third-party ownership or license claims.
No creative agent may merge source, production-sign, publish, or self-promote release state.

fastPath.externalFactNeeded: add Momo only for the bounded fact
